principle: Geometry role is independent from legal identity. A polygon may represent an administrative boundary, a statistical boundary, or a locality footprint without asserting that the geometry is legally authoritative.

administrative_boundary.description: Boundary representation of a current administrative or territorial unit.

statistical_boundary.description: Boundary of a statistical unit such as NUTS or the Moldovan statistical nomenclature.

locality_footprint.description: Polygon representing an inhabited locality footprint, settlement boundary or intravilan/built-up extent.

actual_public_entity_v1.note: ACTUAL v1.0.1 bytes remain immutable. The canonical role is applied by the v1.1 migration rather than rewriting the historical release.
